Indel Signature InsDel_O

InsDel_O

Note

InsDel_O and InsDel_1a as extracted in the 89-type classification have cosine similarity of 0.91 and as extracted in the 476-type classification have cosine similarity of 0.95. On balance we think they are different because of the deletions with microhomology in InsDel1a and the insertions of single T in long-poly-T contexts in InsDel_O.

(corresponds to 83-type signature ID_O )

Note

WARNING: The 83-type ID_O extraction excluded the large proportion of T insertions in long poly-T contexts that were detected in extractions in the 89-type and 476-type classifications. This accounts for the low cosine similarity between the 83-type signature ID_O and the 476-type signature collapsed to the 83-type classification.

In the plot of the 83-type signature converted from the extracted 476-type signature these account for 75% of mutations and the other mutation classes are barely visible.
